taxonomic_note: Stable species-level canonical entry; accepted local infraspecific concept S. drummondii var. texanum is taught internally.
look_here_first: Start with the two-tier leaf pattern: larger lower leaves taper into winged petiole-like bases, while upper branch leaves become much smaller and narrower. Stems and new growth are short-hairy; heads carry pale lavender to whitish rays.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays Natural Purola flora records Symphyotrichum drummondii; Travis herbarium and Williamson county treatment document accepted var. texanum. Current Kew accepts S. drummondii var. texanum.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Exact county evidence; accepted local infraspecific concepts reconciled internally.

best_field_traits: lower leaves relatively large and serrate
lower blades taper into winged petiole-like bases
upper leaves much smaller and narrow
